title: Puharich's assistant says he created the UFO experience with flashing lights

tellings.quote: using flashing lights, using all all all of that stuff was able to create the the the UFO experience. That that stuff was all created, she says.

plain: An unnamed researcher on Jesse Michels's podcast cites a 1994 tape recording made by a man named Dick Russell, in which an assistant to the scientist Andrija Puharich speaks about her old boss. According to the guest, she says Puharich used flashing lights and similar tricks to create the UFO experience, and that all of it was made up. If so, some of the strange events around Puharich would have been staged.
